veranderings.voor: 'n Stut is 'n lang, dun deel van 'n struktuur wat styf bly.
veranderings.na: 'n Stut is 'n lang, dun, stywe deel van 'n struktuur.
veranderings.rede: 'wat styf bly' attaches grammatically to 'struktuur' rather than to the strut; the adjective removes the ambiguity and matches the glossary's 'lang, dun, stywe deel'.

veranderings.voor: Die gewig druk van sy twee ente af
veranderings.na: 'n Gewig druk van sy twee ente af
veranderings.rede: No weight has been mentioned yet, so the definite article has no antecedent; 'daardie gewig' in the next sentence then refers back correctly.
The block uses 'binne-in' for the inside of the body elsewhere; 'binne-in' states more clearly that the hard parts are inside the legs.
A bare 'vou' for a joint reads oddly; 'inmekaar vou' is the natural Afrikaans for a joint collapsing.
